title: Existence of normalized additive Cech comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a set and $U_i$ an open cover of $X$. There exists a normalized additive Cech comparison system [def-pc-cech-comparison-system] on $U$: natural transformations in all abelian sheaves, with the stated degree-zero gluing normalization and connecting-map law for short exact sequences surjective on all tuple intersections.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, normalization and boundary compatibility of the augmented double-complex map

proof.text: Construct the comparison morphisms together with their normalization and connecting law from the augmented injective Cech double-complex construction, then package all fields into CechComparisonSystem.

proof_origin.place: Augmented ordered Cech double-complex construction with compatible connecting maps
